reasoning_content: Now run install.sh non-interactively with QISUTU_INSTALL_LANGUAGE=de (or en). Let's use "de" since docs are German, but any supported. Let's run from /opt/qisutu. This will apt-get install packages, which may take a while. Let's run with a long timeout. Actually apt install of mariadb-server etc could be large but 600s timeout. Let's go.

tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /opt/qisutu && QISUTU_INSTALL_LANGUAGE=de ./install.sh 2>&1 | tail -60; echo \"INSTALL_EXIT=${PIPESTATUS[0]}\"", "security_risk": "HIGH", "summary": "Run Qisutu install.sh system preparation"}
